name: Ja vljubilsja v grafomanku?!
source:
The main character - Kirill Suvorov - unexpectedly successfully falls in love with a girl from his faculty - Tatyana Chertolyas. She is cheerful, kind and very enterprising - besides, it is always interesting with her.

Suddenly it turns out that Tanya is developing visual novels. Immediately she demands to evaluate the results of her work!
Oh, and it will be difficult for him to make the right choice, given that Kirill himself criticizes this genre, and besides, he has a good literary taste!

What will win - the desire for objectivity or love?

[Translated from [url=https://studio-chutzpah.itch.io/ilovegraphomanicgirl]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主角Kirill Suvorov意外地顺利爱上了同系的女孩Tatyana Chertolyas。她开朗、善良、热心，总能让人感到有趣。

没想到Tanya正在创作视觉小说。她立刻要求Kirill评价自己的作品！

考虑到Kirill本人批评这个类型，而且文学品味不俗，要他作出正确评价可不容易！

最终胜出的是对客观的追求，还是爱情？

[译自：[url=https://studio-chutzpah.itch.io/ilovegraphomanicgirl]itch.io[/url]]
